# Four ways to find us at Plugfest


Two sessions, drinks on Tuesday, and throughout the event at the booth.


---


This year there are **two** chances to win a bottle of Midleton’s Very Rare Irish Whiskey – one at The Panel &[The Nightcap (click to register)](https://events.westmonroe.com/event/08bf3115-80bd-4fcc-bb9a-9633e97022a1/register) , and another on the booth. Hand in your business card at both for twice the chance of winning!


---


**Tuesday 13 October – 2.00pm (West Fork 1 Room)**


#### The Panel Session: Sitenna, West Monroe and Automation Exchange


**Four places capital programs go off track**


(And how teams delivering them fix them)


**Baselining** , **execution** , **coordination** and **reporting** – the four areas issues typically arise. In private LTE rollouts most utilities hit all four at once. And the same pattern arises in grid security, DER and fiber.


Daniel Campion, Sitenna CEO, is joined by Tim Valin of West Monroe and Paul Schmidt of Automation Exchange.


West Monroe runs client programs on Sitenna as the single system of record. Automation Exchange does the same for fiber infrastructure delivery at scale. They’ll talk through where each problem used to bite, what changed, and how quickly.


- **Baselining:** Leasing, Network and Ops each hold a different record of the same site, and design starts before anyone reconciles them.
- **Execution:** TIA remediation, site upgrades, new builds and backhaul, spread across dispersed assets with no single view.
- **Coordination:** Data stops at every handoff. The contractors doing the work sit outside every system, so the real status of the program lives in someone’s inbox.
- **Reporting:** Only ever as good as the three stages beneath it. That’s why new dashboards rarely fix it, and why tracker calls take so long.


At this year’s UBBA Summit & Plugfest, Sitenna will be showcasing how customers use our utility solutions to address each of these four challenges, dramatically simplifying and shortening their installation and change programs. Using Sitenna, they’re saving substantial effort, time and money.


**[Read more](https://www.ubbaplugfest.org/agenda)**
